features.technical_goal: Report scoped, explicitly keyed literal fact discrepancies without modifying memories.
features.user_capability: Owner can review potential conflicts instead of silently promoting a newer assertion.
features.integration: Read-only method on current EpisodicMemoryStore, invoked only through existing authorized application boundaries.
features.notes: Draft PR #66 CI Core Assurance: 600 passed, 6 skipped; release-lock PASS. Independent human acceptance/security review remains pending.
features.existing_jas_state: Existing scoped EpisodicMemoryStore persists fact records; new review-only candidate helper is under draft PR #66, not merged.
features.proposed_technology: Existing SQLite and Python standard library; no new external runtime dependency
features.integration_test_criteria: Store integration uses existing scoped SQLite data; end-to-end UI integration not yet performed.
features.unit_test_criteria: Same fact key across a single principal yields bounded untrusted review candidates; invalid bounds rejected.
features.security_test_criteria: No cross-principal leakage, no mutation, no permission grants, malformed tags rejected.
features.acceptance_criteria: Owner-controlled end-to-end review, permissions, temporal precedence and resolution evidence.
features.performance_requirements: Bound at most 1,000 records and return at most 50 candidate keys per call.
features.complexity: LOW-MEDIUM for current primitive; HIGH for trustworthy end-to-end resolution.
features.known_limitations: Literal-value mismatches are not semantic contradictions; old facts outside scan limit not considered.
